name: World Bank
body: Organization JSON-LD with a site search action, a sitemap, robots.txt open to every crawler, and two-year HSTS. What it lacks is a content security policy: none of the pages read sends one.
lesson: Start with Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only to see what would break, then enforce. default-src 'self' is a start.
summary: www.worldbank.org scores 87 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: no content security policy.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: 5 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: /en/news/immersive-story/2026/10/18/jobs-small-ai-private-capital-annual-meetings NewsArticle lacks author, /en/news/immersive-story/2026/10/17/endpoverty-a-world-that-cant-afford-to-wait NewsArticle lacks author,…
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Adobe Analytics appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 7 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: /ext/en/home (72), /en/news/immersive-story/2026/10/18/jobs-small-ai-private-capital-annual-meetings (68), /ext/en/health-works (72), /ext/en/research-publications (67) and 3 more. Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 250 ms
Every page has a meta description
